name: christianpure-topical-bible
title: Bible subjects and their verses
description: 6,699 Bible subjects and the verses on each, one row per subject, verse and source: the OpenBible.info Topical Bible rankings (CC BY 4.0) joined with the verses Christian Pure's own pages quote, and a link to our page where there is one. References only, no Bible text. It powers https://christianpure.com/what-does-the-bible-say-about/. CC BY 4.0: credit OpenBible.info and Christian Pure.

sources.title: OpenBible.info, Topical Bible (CC BY 4.0), downloaded 18 November 2026

resources.name: topical-bible
resources.title: Subjects and verses
resources.description: One row per subject, verse and source.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: The subject, as OpenBible.info names it (names that differ only in spaces or hyphens are joined).

fields.name: topic_key
fields.description: A web-safe key for the subject.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: The verse or passage in English numbering, for example "Philippians 4:6–7".

fields.name: osis
fields.description: The same reference in OSIS form, for example "Phil.4.6-Phil.4.7".

fields.name: source
fields.description: "OpenBible.info" for a verse in its Topical Bible; "Christian Pure" for a verse our page on the subject quotes.

fields.name: openbible_score
fields.description: OpenBible.info's helpfulness score for the verse on that subject (higher is more helpful). Empty for our picks.

fields.name: christianpure_page
fields.description: Our page of verses on the subject, where we have one.
